subject.title: fix(meeting-bot): avoid stale state during transcript and browser recovery

question: Should browser-managed Google Meet talkback intentionally remain fail-closed until an explicit unmuted microphone observation is available, even for existing setups that previously started the bridge while that state was unknown?
rationale: This is a deliberate behavioral tightening with compatibility and availability consequences; source tests establish the mechanics but cannot determine whether the product should preserve the former permissive behavior.

options.title: Accept fail-closed readiness
options.body: Keep the explicit-unmuted requirement and merge after redacted real browser or paired-node proof confirms recovery works without opening a second call tab.

options.title: Preserve permissive compatibility
options.body: Retain the prior unknown-state behavior for existing browser-managed talkback sessions and restrict stricter readiness to a separately approved product path.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed readiness
recommendation.body: Keep the explicit-unmuted requirement and merge after redacted real browser or paired-node proof confirms recovery works without opening a second call tab.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged extraction and all current follow-up changes place this policy decision in the meeting-bot feature boundary they have recently maintained.
